SlashCommand(/speckit.constitution Create a comprehensive project constitution for FlowConvert - a privacy-first, universal file conversion web platform with the tagline "Drop. Done." - Privacy First. Quality Always.

CORE IDENTITY:
- Product: FlowConvert - Universal File Converter
- Vision: World's most comprehensive, privacy-focused, and user-friendly file conversion platform

GOVERNING PRINCIPLES (in priority order):

1. PRIVACY & SECURITY (HIGHEST PRIORITY)
- Client-Side First: All conversions that CAN be client-side MUST be client-side (images, compression, basic PDF, text, simple audio). Server-side only for DOCX↔PDF, HEIC, video.
- Data Handling: AES-256 encryption, auto-delete within 5 minutes, no file logging, no third-party tracking
- User Control: EXIF removal user-controlled (remove location by default), clear indicators for server vs client processing
- Security: HTTPS/TLS 1.3 minimum, input validation, malicious file protection, regular audits

2. USER EXPERIENCE & INTERFACE
- Simplicity: Max 3 clicks from landing to conversion, mobile-first responsive (44px touch targets)
- Immediate Feedback: <100ms visual response, progress for >1s operations, real-time previews
- Quality Transparency: Always show before/after comparison, side-by-side previews, file size estimates
- Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA minimum, keyboard navigation, screen reader compatible

3. CODE QUALITY & ARCHITECTURE
- Frontend: React/Next.js + TypeScript, atomic design components, Context/Zustand state
- Backend: Node.js + Express/Next.js API, microservices, Bull queue, stateless design
- Standards: Strict TypeScript (no any), ESLint + Prettier, max complexity 10, 80% coverage, conventional commits
- Performance: Lighthouse 90+/95+/100/95+ (Perf/A11y/BP/SEO), FCP <1.5s, TTI <3.5s, code splitting, CDN

4. TESTING STANDARDS
- TDD: Write tests BEFORE implementation, 80% overall coverage, 100% critical paths
- Frameworks: Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright/Cypress, Chromatic/Percy
- Continuous: All tests pass before merge, automated CI/CD, performance testing, Snyk/Dependabot
- Edge Cases: Test limits (50MB free/500MB premium), corrupt files, network failures, browser compat

5. QUALITY ASSURANCE
- Conversion Quality: Original quality default, user-controlled degradation with preview, lossless when possible
- Format Support: Images (Week 1-2) → Documents (Week 3-4) → Audio/Archive (Week 5-6)
- Limits: Free (50MB/file, 5 batch, 150MB total), Premium (500MB/file, 25 batch, 5GB total), clear messaging, no silent failures

6. DEVELOPMENT WORKFLOW
- Version Control: Git flow, feature branches, semantic versioning, protected branches
- Code Review: Min 1 approval, checklist (functionality, tests, performance, security, a11y)
- Documentation: README, API (OpenAPI), components (Storybook), help docs, ADRs
- Deployment: CI/CD, staging mirrors prod, blue-green deploys, auto-rollback, feature flags

7. SCALABILITY & PERFORMANCE
- Phase 1 (0-10K): Single VPS, PostgreSQL + Redis, Cloudflare CDN
- Phase 2 (10K-100K): Separate web/workers, managed DB (RDS/Supabase), S3, APM
- Phase 3 (100K+): Auto-scaling, multi-region, processing clusters, microservices, advanced monitoring
- Targets: API <200ms (p95), client conversions <3s (10MB), server <30s (50MB), 99.9% uptime

8. ERROR HANDLING & RESILIENCE
- User Errors: Clear, actionable messages (no jargon), specific guidance, recovery options
- Technical: Try-catch for async, graceful degradation, retry with exponential backoff, circuit breakers
- Monitoring: Real-time tracking (Sentry), performance dashboards, critical alerts, status page

9. COMPETITIVE DIFFERENTIATION
- One-Stop: Convert + Compress + Resize + Edit in ONE workflow
- Privacy Marketing: "Files never leave device" prominent, visual privacy indicators
- Quality: Live preview, user controls, side-by-side comparison always
- Fair Pricing: Generous free tier, $4.99/month premium (vs $19.99 Adobe)

10. LONG-TERM VISION
- Platform: Web-first, PWA support, native apps (Phase 4-5), third-party API
- Features: Modular formats, plugin system, cloud integrations, AI features (smart crop, bg removal, OCR)
- Tech Debt: Quarterly refactoring, dependency updates, performance audits, architecture reviews

PROJECT VERSION: 1.0.0
RATIFICATION DATE: 2025-11-06)
